method: source/API/UI/collector/persistence and safety-gate inspection; no Windows runtime execution

features.feature: پنجرهٔ مانیتور زندهٔ مستقل / پاپ‌آپ
features.current_evidence: ui.ps1: only completed observe JSON is shown
features.restoration_requirement: Restore docked live view plus independent non-modal popup sharing one recorder, not two captures.

features.feature: پالس کشف، نمونهٔ جدید و دیده‌شدن دوباره
features.current_evidence: ui.ps1: no live frame polling or pulse state
features.restoration_requirement: Restore distinct textual and optional subtle color signals; pulses mean sampled TCP state, never packets/HTTP.

features.feature: نمایش حضور در آخرین نمونه / رکورد تاریخی
features.restoration_requirement: Reset presence only after a successful sample; failure must mean unknown, not absent.

features.feature: همیشه روی پنجره‌ها / پنهان و بازکردن مانیتور
features.restoration_requirement: Restore user-controlled topmost/hide/show; hiding must not stop recording.

features.feature: مکث نمایش بدون توقف ضبط
features.restoration_requirement: Pause rendering only; recording and storage continue, with a persistent paused label.

features.feature: دنبال‌کردن ردیف تازه و خاموش‌کردن پالس
features.restoration_requirement: Restore configurable follow and reduced-motion/pulse-off options.

features.feature: مدت ۶۰، ۱۲۰، ۳۰۰ ثانیه و تا توقف
features.current_evidence: cli.py observe limits 1..120; ui.ps1 numeric duration
features.restoration_requirement: Restore original recording choices only in a separately reviewed read-only recorder path; never extend native mutation timeouts.

features.feature: پیام آمادگی ضبط پیش از اجرای برنامه
features.restoration_requirement: Readiness must follow successful setup; selecting an EXE must never launch it.

features.feature: سلامت ضبط، فریم مانده، خطای خواندن و انتشار
features.current_evidence: ui.ps1 reports final query errors only
features.restoration_requirement: Live heartbeat, frame age, query/publication errors, caps and finalization must be visible separately.

features.feature: توقف، انتظار نهایی‌سازی و نتیجهٔ نهایی معتبر
features.current_evidence: ui.ps1 stop.txt and close waits for worker
features.restoration_requirement: Keep existing stop semantics; distinguish stopping, finalized and failed; do not treat latest live frame as saved final capture.

features.feature: جدول دیداری مقصدهای رصدشده
features.restoration_requirement: Restore IP, port, protocol, EXE path, PID, process start, TCP states, samples and first/last UTC columns.

features.feature: تفکیک فرایند تازه از قدیمی
features.current_evidence: observe-core.ps1 retains ticks but not process-freshness UX
features.restoration_requirement: Use process birth vs capture start, exact path and PID+birth; unknown remains unknown.

features.feature: تفکیک مقصد تازه، قدیمی و سابقهٔ نامطمئن
features.restoration_requirement: Keep destination freshness independent of process age and scoped per exact EXE identity in multi-EXE version.

features.feature: تطابق با Block تأییدشده و تب زیر پوشش Block
features.current_evidence: preview/decision are desired-policy model, not active-rule readback
features.restoration_requirement: Restore read-only exact native readback with timestamp and unknown status; stored configuration is not proof of active Block or packet drops.

features.feature: بازبینی تفکیک Block و فیلتر موارد تحت پوشش
features.restoration_requirement: Read-only reclassification; stale/unknown matches remain visible, never silently hide them.

features.feature: انتخاب مقصد و افزودن مستقیم آن به بلک‌لیست
features.current_evidence: add_blacklist accepts manual target only in UI
features.restoration_requirement: Restore checked observed rows mapped to their actual EXE IDs; add to config only, never automatic Apply.

features.feature: دیدن حالت‌ها، PID، زمان‌ها و دفعات نمونه
features.current_evidence: observe-core.ps1 stores raw values; UI only JSON
features.restoration_requirement: Restore readable table/details; samples are not bytes, packets or successful requests.

features.feature: مرحلهٔ جاری اجرای برنامه / ورود / داشبورد / بازی
features.restoration_requirement: Restore explicit user selection, append-only UTC journal and recorder acknowledgment; not automatic game-state detection.

features.feature: مرحله‌ها و برچسب چندانتخابی هر ردیف
features.restoration_requirement: Restore independent row annotations, bulk edit and durable saves with error/unsaved indicators.

features.feature: تفکیک مرحلهٔ همین ضبط و سابقهٔ ضبط‌های دیگر
features.restoration_requirement: Never project previous-capture labels as actual current-stage observations.

features.feature: حفظ برچسب‌های زنده و بازیابی هنگام نهایی‌سازی
features.restoration_requirement: Persist labels separately from immutable raw recordings, preserve journals on failure.

features.feature: شواهد DNS واقعی از لاگ موجود Sysmon 22
features.restoration_requirement: Read existing enabled logs only; do not install Sysmon or change audit/log configuration.

features.feature: رویداد منع اتصال WFP / Security 5157
features.restoration_requirement: Show exact logged application attribution, protocol and timestamp; do not claim the event belongs to this firewall rule.

features.feature: نمایش نگاشت hosts مرتبط با DNS ثبت‌شده
features.restoration_requirement: Keep hosts config, DNS observation and actual blocking distinct; do not infer connection-domain identity from PTR.

features.feature: وضعیت دسترسی و کامل‌بودن منابع رویداد
features.restoration_requirement: Unreadable/disabled/partial logs are unknown coverage, not evidence of no traffic.

features.feature: PTR انتخاب‌ها، همهٔ قابل‌بررسی و استعلام تازه
features.original_evidence: dns_lookup.py Resolver; ui-tools.ps1 Start-LivePtr; ui.ps1 LookupNames
features.restoration_requirement: Restore explicit public-literal-IP lookups, cache freshness, per-query bounds and no actual-domain claim.

features.feature: پیشرفت PTR، توقف و ادامهٔ مستقل ضبط
features.restoration_requirement: One bounded read-only resolver worker can coexist with recording; no native mutation parallelism.

features.feature: ذخیرهٔ ضبط، خواندن فهرست و بازکردن ضبط قدیمی
features.current_evidence: jobs response files exist, but no capture browser/API
features.restoration_requirement: Restore validated capture storage and history UI, separate from transient job outputs.

features.feature: مقایسهٔ دقیق دو ضبط
features.restoration_requirement: Compare EXE identity + destination/protocol; different durations/quality/stages must be warned, absence is not blocking success.

features.feature: خروجی تحلیلی ZIP و گزارش خواندنی
features.restoration_requirement: Restore explicit export of selected captures, annotations, source limits and privacy disclosure; never auto-upload.

features.feature: حذف رکورد با حفظ خام محلی
features.restoration_requirement: Keep logical deletions separate from raw recordings; excluded rows must remain excluded from later exports.

features.feature: حذف ضبط با سطل محلی
features.restoration_requirement: Validate selection before moving raw capture and sidecars, retain recovery in local trash.

features.feature: نمایش و خواندن استاندارد فایل hosts
features.restoration_requirement: Restore full-domain view, address list, mapping type, invalid/truncated warning and source hash.

features.feature: افزودن دامنه برای انسداد با نگاشت محلی
features.restoration_requirement: Restore separate explicit system-wide consent; show IPv4/IPv6 mappings and no per-EXE scope promise.

features.feature: ویرایش و حذف نگاشت انتخابی دامنه
features.restoration_requirement: Preserve unrelated aliases, comments, encoding/newlines and protected system names.

features.feature: پشتیبان، کنترل hash، قفل انحصاری و بازخوانی
features.restoration_requirement: Restore verified backup before change, stale-read rejection, readback, hardlink/reparse refusal and truthful partial-failure status.

features.feature: بازگردانی داخل همان عملیات در صورت شکست نوشتن
features.restoration_requirement: Restore existing same-handle rollback safeguards; never promise rollback after power loss or report success if rollback fails.

features.feature: دکمهٔ مستقل Restore hosts از پشتیبان
features.original_evidence: hosts_edit.py has backup+in-operation rollback, no standalone restore UI
features.restoration_requirement: Potential new improvement, not a dropped old feature; needs separate safe stale-hash/backup/ownership design.

features.feature: IP/CIDR، TCP/UDP و پورت
features.restoration_requirement: Keep new exact program IDs and stricter shared policy validation.

features.feature: ورود TXT، خروجی TXT و ذخیرهٔ مستقل فهرست
features.current_evidence: JSON config save/import exists; no equivalent TXT buttons
features.restoration_requirement: Restore TXT import/export with preview and atomic config staging, not Apply; make per-EXE assignment explicit.

features.feature: فرم آسان رنج: الگو، ابتدا/انتها و CIDR با پوشش دقیق
features.current_evidence: manual IP/CIDR/range target exists; no wizard
features.restoration_requirement: Restore pure preview with first/last/address count and explicit assignment to selected EXEs; no automatic broadening.

features.feature: وضعیت واقعی هر ردیف قانون و دلیل انتخاب
features.current_evidence: native_status raw summary; blacklist grid lacks per-row readback
features.restoration_requirement: Show desired vs journal-owned vs ActiveStore-verified status; do not equate config with active protection.

features.feature: حذف تکی، حذف و اعمال، اعمال و بستن
features.current_evidence: delete selected config; explicit Restore/Apply separate
features.restoration_requirement: Retain convenience only through unchanged native ownership/readback/confirm gates; do not silently replace an active journal session.

features.feature: تأیید اضافی برای پوشش شبکه/رنج
features.current_evidence: whole-plan LAB confirmation exists, no separate range consent
features.restoration_requirement: Restore additional risk acknowledgment before any broad-range Apply without weakening current LAB confirmation.

features.feature: هشدار ویژهٔ مقصد حساس ورود
features.restoration_requirement: Reinstate reviewed risk warning and explicit acknowledgment; never add a bypass or infer exemption from whitelist.

features.feature: دو-store readback و بازیابی قواعد خودی
features.restoration_requirement: Keep new journal-exact, drift-refusing Restore; never reintroduce broad group deletion or rule adoption.

features.feature: حفظ قواعد پس از بسته‌شدن برنامه
features.restoration_requirement: State clearly that closing/config deletion is not Restore; changing hosts also persists system-wide.

features.feature: کنترل هویت مسیر/هش EXE و تغییر فایل
features.restoration_requirement: Keep per-EXE SHA256, immutable plan digest/generation and native gate checks.

features.feature: ارتقای خودکار UAC در شروع
features.current_evidence: launch.py no auto elevation; explicit Run as administrator
features.restoration_requirement: Do not restore auto-elevation silently; keep explicit user launch unless separately requested.

features.feature: انتخاب حداکثر ۳۲ EXE و شناسهٔ مسیر مستقل
features.original_evidence: old backend restricts selected Wow executable
features.restoration_requirement: All restored monitors, evidence, histories and actions must retain per-EXE identity; no collapse by filename or PID alone.

features.feature: تیک پایدار، فیلتر و شمارش انتخاب‌های پنهان
features.original_evidence: old observed checks use record identity
features.current_evidence: ui.ps1 checks keyed by stable program ID
features.restoration_requirement: Preserve current checked-set contract and extend to observed records; highlight is not an execution set.

features.feature: وایت‌لیست سراسری و kill-switch
features.original_evidence: not implemented by standalone blacklist app
features.current_evidence: shared compiler preview; native global whitelist gated; full isolation unimplemented
features.restoration_requirement: Do not label these as restored/working; preserve gates until qualified. hosts blocking is not a per-EXE whitelist feature.
